summary: 46 units (391-436); 37 units need fixes; 35 error and 22 minor issues. Main classes: Hindi brackets/parentheses and supplied words; hari rendered 'green' (हरे) instead of भूरा; vāja/iṣ/andhas/indu/dyumna/sridh/hotṛ/vipra glossary renderings; invented or wrong split forms (ā-ninaya, ud-ā, udīrate silently corrected); wrong case labels (arvā, tyat); participle rendered as finite verbs (392); 'he/his' added to the anu svarājyam refrain; unclear text (396, 420, 422, 423, 407) given firm readings. No regrouping suggested. Every unit remains an unreviewed AI draft; several (396, 399, 407, 412, 416, 420, 422) stay low-confidence and need a human reading.
